literalFactsParaphrased: The profile is Chemistry year 12 at this native requirement level. LB4 Chemical Bonding has approximately 13 hours.
Competency 3 connects hydrogen wave-function and probability-density representations to energy schemes and infers second-period diatomic molecule or ion existence.
Competency 4 prescribes explaining simple homonuclear diatomic energy schemes through LCAO of compatible energy and symmetry.
The assigned content specifies LCAO, orbital conservation, bonding and antibonding MOs, sigma/pi overlap and the bonding relationships of H2, F2, N2 and O2 as examples.
Simple sigma/pi energy schemes, HOMO/LUMO and three-dimensional bonding/antibonding representations are explicitly assigned.

scientificCorroborationOnly.title: MIT 5.111 Lecture Summary 13, Molecular Orbital Theory, 6 October 2014
scientificCorroborationOnly.factsParaphrased: Page 4 defines simple MO bond order from half the net bonding electron population. Page 8 supplies N2/O2 configurations and distinguishes their MO level order. Valence-only counts give N2 (8-2)/2=3 and O2 (8-4)/2=2. The same named diagram interpretation thus gives the canonical quantitative output.
